### Upgrading OmikujiBot / Newly Installing OmikujiBot Editor

> You can check the current version in **OmikujiBot Editor**.
> Even if your package does not include "OmikujiBot Editor", **you can follow this upgrade procedure to install it as a new installation.**

#### Upgrade Procedure

![](../../../images/installation-1792770461531.webp)

1. Download the [latest version](https://github.com/Pintocuru/OmikujiBot-Docs/releases/latest) from GitHub.
2. Under **"Assets"** at the bottom of the release notes, download the file named **"OmikujiBot_core\_"**.
3. **Unzip** the downloaded ZIP file.

   ![](../../../images/installation-1792770471574.webp)

4. **Launch OneComme.**
5. On the "Templates" screen, select the template you want to upgrade and click **"Open Folder"** on the right.
6. **Overwrite** the files in the opened folder with the unzipped files.
7. To be safe, **launch OmikujiBot Editor and check that the version is up to date.**

- **Note**: After upgrading, some settings may revert to their defaults. Be sure to make a backup first.
